card.fires_on: The word "with" (or the space after "cleansed with") right after a verb of cleaning or wiping a skin site, vial stopper or syringe. It fires where the next word is expected to be alcohol or an alcohol swab.

modes.label: Clean/wipe + with
modes.description: The word "with" after clean, cleanse or wipe plus a body site or vial part, in injection-prep steps.
